description: Scales, offsets and limits a signal, for turning one voltage range into another

params.text: Multiplies the input, from -100% to 100%, with negative settings flipping its polarity; the menu raises the multiplier for more than unity gain
Adds a fixed voltage after the gain, from -10V to 10V
Sets the highest voltage the output can reach, after gain and offset
Sets the lowest voltage the output can reach, after gain and offset

outputs.text: The signal after gain, offset and limiting

menu: Gain multiplier — multiplies the range of the gain knob by 1x, 10x, 100x or 1000x
Reflect at maximum — folds the signal back down from the MAX setting instead of flattening it against it
Reflect at minimum — folds the signal back up from the MIN setting instead of flattening it against it
